summary: OTP bypass verification for guest users - ALL 6 TESTS PASSED. Verified that users with guestMobile or userPhone in localStorage can skip OTP verification across all booking flows: DiaGyn appointments, PharmacyCheckout, MangoCheckout, and UnifiedCheckout. The fix correctly detects guestMobile OR userPhone and shows verified state with disabled phone field and 'Book Appointment' button instead of 'Continue'.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage simulation: guestMobile=9876543210 OR userPhone=9876543210, patientName=Test Guest/Login User, pharmacyCart/labCart items
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP bypass fix verified working in all 4 booking flows. The fix uses guestMobile || userPhone check in localStorage to auto-bypass OTP verification. Key assertions: 1) Phone field auto-filled, 2) Phone field disabled, 3) 'Verified via login' badge shown, 4) Button says 'Book Appointment' not 'Continue'.
